First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: family pace.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Keizer Family Ride group ride

A Thursday evening family ride from Cummings Elementary in Keizer, north of Salem. Listed on the Salem Bicycle Club calendar every Thursday through early October. Registration on the club site is encouraged but not required.
